next.reason: 1985 VIII.3.2.3 SR3 (relative I-O): 'One or more record description entries must follow the file description entry.' 2023 brackets the record-description-entry group after file-description-entry in §2023:13.4.2; §2023:13.4.5.3 SR7 requires record descriptions only 'For an indexed file'; §2023:13.4.5.3 SR3 and §2023:13.18.43.3 SR1 let a relative FD have none when a RECORD clause is given, WRITE/REWRITE use the FILE and FROM phrases and READ uses INTO. A relative FD without record descriptions, refused in 1985, is accepted: a compile-time relaxation, no exception condition.
